external_findings.title: Command Injection Risk via Shell Interpreter
external_findings.description: Command string in ExecuteShellScript at line 29 is passed directly from function parameter 'userInput' to shell interpreter 'cmd.exe -c'.
external_findings.root_cause: Executing arbitrary untrusted shell strings with shell interpretation (-c).
external_findings.recommended_action: Invoke target executable directly with discrete arguments instead of passing shell commands through 'sh -c'.
